text:
jordan: Heads up — PR #3456 is stuck in merge-queue. Merge blocked by failing integ job on shard-5. Anyone free to trigger a targeted rerun? :wave:

ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline 'redwood/merge-queue' — job integration-shard-5 FAILED
```
FAIL tests/test_session_timeout.py::test_reconnect — Timeout after 10s
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```

maria: I can rerun in a minute. Do we want targeted rerun or full queue? I'm leaning targeted to avoid churn. :+1:

ashok: Agreed targeted. Looks flaky — reproduces ~1/50 locally for me. If rerun fails again we should bisect the last commit in the PR's diff.

devon: If CI passes on rerun can someone drop an approval? I'm OOO for next 2h. Otherwise it will sit in queue.

jordan: @maria thanks. When you rerun can you use the focused command:
```
/buildkite/rerun --pipeline merge-queue --job integration-shard-5 --targeted
```

maria: kicked it. buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/merge-queue/builds/7890 :rocket:

ci-bot: build 7890 — job integration-shard-5 RUNNING

ci-bot: build 7890 — job integration-shard-5 PASSED

maria: PASSED :tada: @devon @ashok can one of you approve? I don't want to merge without a quick code-review glance.

ashok: giving a quick look now. minor nits, not blocking. lgtm. :eyes:

devon: lgtm from me too. dropping `approved-by` label. :white_check_mark:

jordan: merging now. Notes: follow-up task to add a retry wrapper for that test in flaky-tests doc. Filed issue https://github.com/redwoodinc/infra/issues/412

maria: Thanks all. Tagging for postmortem if it reoccurs: #flaky-tests

ci-bot: merge completed for PR #3456 — merged by jordan

jordan: (post-merge) We should add a short blurb in the PR about why we accepted the rerun and the triage plan. Will paste into release notes.

devon: 👍
